beats.label: S1 · Detective from the Tail
beats.text: Layton, a Tailie ex-detective, is pulled to the front to solve a murder. He uses the access to secretly plan a revolt from the tail.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Establishes Layton, the class geography, and the covert revolution that drives every later plot.

beats.label: S1 · The Wilford lie
beats.text: Investigating the case, Layton uncovers the train's biggest secret: Mr. Wilford is dead, and Melanie has been impersonating him from the start.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The revelation that reframes Melanie for the whole series and creates the Wilford vacuum Big Alice will fill.

beats.label: S1 · Stasis and escape
beats.text: Melanie drugs Layton and hides him in the passenger stasis Drawers. Josie tracks him down and breaks him out with the help of a defecting brakeman.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Introduces the Drawers (Big Alice's future cargo threat) and the Josie–Layton bond the next season pivots on.

beats.label: S1 · Josie dies
beats.text: Melanie tortures Josie for Layton's whereabouts; Josie dies in the escape. A grieving Layton triggers the full third-class revolution.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The atrocity that snaps the revolt live and whose consequences hang over every Layton–Melanie scene after.

beats.label: S1 · Seven cars cut loose
beats.text: To break First Class's Jackboot army, Layton decouples seven cars mid-run, killing the Folgers, Commander Grey, and captured allies alike.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The victory Layton has to live with; establishes that leading Snowpiercer costs civilian lives, a beat the show keeps returning to.

beats.label: S1 · Democracy, then a signal
beats.text: Melanie hands the train to Layton, who promises democracy — until a strange signal reveals a second train, Big Alice, docking behind them.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Transfers power and immediately undercuts it: the whole S2 arc launches from this moment.

beats.label: S1 · Alexandra Cavill
beats.text: Big Alice's envoy demands surrender in Mr. Wilford's name, and identifies herself as Alexandra Cavill, Melanie's daughter, long presumed dead.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Introduces Alex, the single most important new character of S2, and the personal lever Wilford will use against Melanie.

cliffhanger.text: Big Alice has clamped onto Snowpiercer and stopped it dead. Its envoy speaks for Mr. Wilford himself — and she is Melanie's long-lost daughter.
questions: Is the real Mr. Wilford alive aboard Big Alice, or is this another lie?
How did Alex survive the Freeze, and whose side is she on?
Can Layton hold the train he just won against a second Engine and its crew?

characters.name: Andre Layton
characters.line: Tail ex-detective who led the revolution; now provisional leader of Snowpiercer.

characters.name: Melanie Cavill
characters.line: Architect of the Wilford lie who kept the train running for seven years; has just handed control to Layton.

characters.name: Mr. Wilford
characters.line: Mythic founder of Snowpiercer, believed dead — until Big Alice arrived speaking his name.

characters.name: Alexandra "Alex" Cavill
characters.line: Melanie's daughter, presumed dead in the Freeze, now Big Alice's envoy.

characters.name: Ruth Wardell
characters.line: Head of Hospitality; a Wilford loyalist who turned on Melanie once the lie was exposed.

characters.name: Bennett Knox
characters.line: Engineer who has driven Snowpiercer with Melanie since day one.

characters.name: Zarah Ferami
characters.line: Layton's ex-wife, now pregnant with his child; stayed at the front through the revolt.

characters.name: Josie
characters.line: Layton's Tail love, tortured to death by Melanie during the revolution.

characters.name: Till
characters.line: Brakeman who defected to Layton's side and helped Josie free him from the Drawers.

characters.name: LJ Folger
characters.line: Sadistic First Class teen orphaned by the revolt; evicted from the Folger compartment by Pike, now bonding with Oz.

characters.name: Pike
characters.line: Tailie freed from the Drawers by the Folgers; volatile, warns Layton's rule will crumble.

beats.label: S2 · Wilford, in the flesh
beats.text: Wilford proves himself alive on Big Alice, using Melanie's long-lost daughter Alex to fracture her loyalty and pressure Snowpiercer into concessions.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Confirms the S1 cliffhanger and installs the season's antagonist plus his personal lever against Melanie.

beats.label: S2 · The world is warming
beats.text: A weather balloon confirms Melanie's theory that Earth is warming. She sets out alone for a research station to find a habitable spot for landing.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Introduces the mission — finding warm ground — that becomes the show's entire forward direction.

beats.label: S2 · Josie, alive
beats.text: Josie is revealed alive but frostbitten, secretly recovering under Wilford's scientists; she begins smuggling intelligence back to Layton.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Brings back a S1 casualty and plants the cold-resistance treatment that becomes a plot lever in later seasons.

beats.label: S2 · Melanie stranded
beats.text: The train misses the station and leaves Melanie stranded on the ice. Her preserved data confirms several habitable warming spots do exist.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Removes the show's other lead from the board and hands the mission's proof to Layton to act on.

beats.label: S2 · Engine seized
beats.text: Wilford's saboteur damages Snowpiercer's Engine; Layton is forced to let Wilford in to fix it, and Wilford uses the moment to retake the train.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Reverses the S1 outcome and sets up the six-month Wilford regime that opens S3.

beats.label: S2 · Alex defects
beats.text: Alex, sickened after learning Wilford culled half of Big Alice's crew, defects. She and Layton break away a ten-car pirate train to find Melanie.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Locks Alex onto the Layton side of the split and creates the tiny expeditionary crew that carries S3.

beats.label: S2 · The station is empty
beats.text: They reach the station and find Melanie gone, presumed frozen to death — but her data lights the way to the last habitable ground on Earth.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Confirms the search target for S3 while leaving Melanie's fate ambiguous, the season's dominant open question.

cliffhanger.text: Wilford now controls both Snowpiercer and Big Alice. Layton, Alex and a handful of allies are alone on a ten-car pirate train, chasing Melanie's data toward the last warm spot on Earth.
questions: Can a ten-car pirate train survive long enough to find New Eden?
Will Wilford come after them, or turn Snowpiercer into something worse?
Is Melanie really dead, or did she walk somewhere before the freeze took her?

characters.name: Andre Layton
characters.line: Deposed by Wilford; now leads a tiny pirate train hunting for the warm spot Melanie's data promised.

characters.name: Melanie Cavill
characters.line: Believed frozen to death outside the station; her preserved data is the only reason there is a mission at all.

characters.name: Mr. Wilford
characters.line: Has retaken Snowpiercer and now controls both trains.

characters.name: Alex
characters.line: Abandoned Wilford after seeing him cull his own crew; now on the pirate train with Layton.

characters.name: Josie
characters.line: Alive with cold-resistant abilities from the Headwoods' experiments; escaped on the pirate train.
characters.note: Presumed dead at the end of S1.

characters.name: Bennett
characters.line: Driving the pirate train's engine for Layton.

characters.name: Till
characters.line: Snowpiercer's train detective, on the pirate train.

characters.name: Ruth Wardell
characters.line: Accidentally left behind on Snowpiercer; a Wilford resister at the front.

characters.name: Zarah
characters.line: Chose to stay on Snowpiercer, still carrying Layton's child.

characters.name: Miss Audrey
characters.line: Wilford's former lover; taken as a hostage on the pirate train.

beats.label: S3 · Six months in the dark
beats.text: Six months on, Wilford rules a starving Big Alice while Ruth leads a hidden resistance; Layton's pirate Snowpiercer searches for warm ground, in vain.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Resets both sides of the story and shows the mission is failing, which is why Layton later grasps at Africa.

beats.label: S3 · Horn of Africa
beats.text: Layton rescues Asha from a bunker in North Korea and, following a vision, fixes on the Horn of Africa as the site of the last warm spot.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Names the destination that becomes New Eden, and introduces Asha, whose lie he will build his mandate on.

beats.label: S3 · Big Alice retaken, on a lie
beats.text: The pirate train retakes Big Alice from Wilford. To win the vote for Africa, Layton lies that Asha was already found living at New Eden.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Reunites the trains under Layton and plants the deceit that fractures his leadership by season's end.

beats.label: S3 · Pike, and a duel
beats.text: Pike, blaming Layton for the Tailies lost in the old revolution, turns to bombs. Layton kills him in a ritual duel, and it breaks him.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Shows Layton's authority curdling into violence against his own; the head injury from this fight shakes his faith.

beats.label: S3 · Melanie found alive
beats.text: An old signal picked up by Wilford leads a track-scaler party to find Melanie alive, sustained on stasis drugs through months on the ice.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Returns the show's other lead just in time to blow up Layton's plan.

beats.label: S3 · Melanie exposes Layton
beats.text: Reviewing the data, Melanie warns the Africa track is unsafe. Then she publicly exposes Layton's lie and seizes the Engine to stop him.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The betrayal that forces the trains' split; puts Melanie and Layton on opposite sides for the finale.

beats.label: S3 · The split
beats.text: The two settle it without war: Big Alice heads for New Eden, Snowpiercer stays with Melanie, and Wilford is exiled on a lone track-scaler.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Establishes the two-community, one-exile geography that S4 opens inside.

cliffhanger.text: Big Alice's passengers reach the Horn of Africa and find it warm and habitable — New Eden is real. Months later, Melanie, still driving Snowpiercer around the world, spots a rocket exploding on the horizon.
questions: How long will New Eden's warm spot actually last?
Who launched the rocket, and are they friendly?
Can two split communities — with an exiled Wilford loose on the ice — survive the coming test?

characters.name: Andre Layton
characters.line: Leader at New Eden, with Josie; his lie about how he found the place is now public knowledge.

characters.name: Melanie Cavill
characters.line: Recovered from the ice; chose to keep driving Snowpiercer rather than settle at New Eden.

characters.name: Alex
characters.line: Melanie's daughter; chose to stay at New Eden after the split.

characters.name: Josie
characters.line: Layton's partner at New Eden; her cold-resistance is now dulling her sense of pain.

characters.name: Ruth Wardell
characters.line: At New Eden; became the moral centre of the resistance during Wilford's rule.

characters.name: Bennett
characters.line: Stayed on Snowpiercer with Melanie, now her partner.

characters.name: Till
characters.line: Remained on Snowpiercer at the last minute to stay with Audrey.

characters.name: Miss Audrey
characters.line: On Snowpiercer, in a new relationship with Till.

characters.name: Zarah
characters.line: At New Eden, co-parenting baby Liana with Layton after their split.

characters.name: Liana Layton
characters.line: Andre and Zarah's infant daughter, born on the pirate train.

characters.name: Mr. Wilford
characters.line: Exiled on the track-scaler; alive, alone, still out there on the ice.

beats.label: S4 · Milius takes Snowpiercer
beats.text: Nine months on, Admiral Milius' paramilitary force has seized Snowpiercer; his scientists plan to launch a compound they claim will end the Freeze.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Names the season's antagonist and mission, and explains where Snowpiercer has been.

beats.label: S4 · Raid on New Eden
beats.text: Milius' men storm New Eden, kill Zarah, and snatch baby Liana. Layton takes Big Alice to get his daughter back.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The inciting shock that puts Layton on the rescue mission driving the middle of the season.

beats.label: S4 · Wilford, again
beats.text: In the rescue, Layton learns Wilford is alive, allied with Milius, and behind the kidnapping — a plot to harvest Josie's blood for his cold cure.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Restores Wilford as the season's real puppetmaster and explains why Liana was taken alive.

beats.label: S4 · Bennett's sacrifice
beats.text: Bennett sacrifices himself to sever Big Alice from Snowpiercer, letting Ruth and Till drive it back to New Eden with the freed passengers.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Kills off Melanie's partner and hands the resistance the train it needs to hold New Eden.

beats.label: S4 · Gemini is a poison
beats.text: Melanie discovers Gemini, the compound meant to stop the Freeze, is poisoning Alex — and if launched, it will strip the atmosphere and kill all life.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Inverts the mission: stopping the launch is now the whole point of everything that follows.

beats.label: S4 · Nima named, Wilford gone
beats.text: Wilford reveals that Nima, the mission's lead scientist, is the man who created CW-7 in the first place, then kills himself before Layton can.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Ties the whole apocalypse to a single villain and takes Wilford off the board on his own terms.

beats.label: S4 · Last stop
beats.text: Nima attacks New Eden; Alex sabotages the launch, the settlers win the fight, everyone chooses to stay, and flowers begin appearing on the ice.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Resolves the series: the launch is stopped, the community stays, and the planet quietly begins to heal on its own.

cliffhanger.text: The launch is stopped and Snowpiercer is grounded to help power New Eden. Far beyond the warm spot, flowers have begun to grow on their own — the Earth may be healing without them.
questions: Will New Eden's warm spot hold long enough for the recovery to spread?
Can Snowpiercer be retrofitted before its remaining power runs out?
Is the planet really coming back, or is this another false spring?

characters.name: Andre Layton
characters.line: Leader of the New Eden community; got Liana back and stopped Nima.

characters.name: Melanie Cavill
characters.line: Back with Alex after Bennett's death; helped foil the launch.

characters.name: Alex
characters.line: Sabotaged the launch that would have ended all life on Earth.

characters.name: Josie
characters.line: Layton's partner; her cold-adapted blood was what Wilford was after.

characters.name: Ruth Wardell
characters.line: Rallied Big Alice's passengers into the rebellion that retook the train.

characters.name: Liana Layton
characters.line: Layton's daughter, safely returned to New Eden.

characters.name: Zarah
characters.line: Killed by Milius' men when they raided New Eden for Liana.

characters.name: Bennett
characters.line: Died freezing on the coupling so Ruth and Till could steal Big Alice back.

characters.name: Mr. Wilford
characters.line: Killed himself with a poisoned blunt after naming Nima as the man who caused the Freeze.

characters.name: Dr. Nima Rosseau
characters.line: Creator of CW-7 and lead scientist of Gemini; walked into the ice after his launch failed.
